speech.welcome: Kuromi's here! Drag me to move, click me to chat.
lines: Hmph—today I'll be cute AND rebellious!
My Melody? I-I wasn't thinking about her at all!
A little mischief can still be sweet.
You came to see me again? Good taste.
Wanna pull a harmless prank together today?
Don't poke me too much—I'll get shy.
My cuteness is a limited edition, got it?
